name: Do I need a permit for basement wall framing in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for basement wall framing in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in Daly City and most Bay Area municipalities, you typically need a building permit for basement wall framing if it's part of a larger renovation that creates new living space, alters the structure, or involves electrical, plumbing, or HVAC work. Even if it's just non-load-bearing walls, local building departments often require permits to ensure the work meets safety and structural codes. It's best to consult with your contractor or the local planning department early in the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, permits are generally required for basement wall framing in Daly City, especially if creating new living space or altering utilities. Always check with the local planning department.
